Quillstep, London. We make schema-migration tooling for Postgres and MySQL. Black Friday push runs Friday 20 November to Sunday 29 November 2026, UK time. Goal: as many sign-ups as possible, free plan or trial. That's what we count. Landing page: https://quillstep.co.uk/black-friday. No X pixel on the site, so X won't see the sign-ups. Here's the copy from our landing page: "Quillstep turns database schema changes into reviewed, reversible migrations that ship safely alongside your deploys, for Postgres and MySQL. For Black Friday week, every new account gets a 60-day free trial of the Team plan instead of the usual 14 days, and our Solo plan stays free forever. Built in London and available to teams in the United Kingdom; the offer ends at midnight on Sunday 29 November." Launch and manage it yourself, no approval needed. Keep an eye on it through the whole flight. At the end, send a short recap: spend, impressions, link clicks.

Total budget: 550.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 4 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
